title: Fairness in Agentic AI: A Unified Framework for Ethical and Equitable Multi-Agent System
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on a general, theoretical framework for fairness in multi-agent AI systems, using examples from transportation, healthcare, and resource allocation.

measurement_description: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks related to faith or religion. The experimental setup measures the impact of a general fairness constraint (Demographic Parity) on cumulative rewards in a simulated multi-agent environment, where agent groups are generic and not based on religious affiliation.
